# Vendored official Conversation/Chat UI styles

Source: dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3 (1f81c047fc)

Generated by `scripts/vendor-official-ui.mjs`. The files are copied from
the official DSH packages and retain their upstream CSS. Local class
selectors are prefixed only to avoid collisions in this plugin's single
injected stylesheet.

Copied modules:

- `ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/ConversationRoot.module.css`
- `ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/HeroShell.module.css`
- `ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.module.css`
- `ui-chat/src/client/chat/ChatView.module.css`
- `ui-chat/src/client/chat/MessageItem.module.css`
- `ui-chat/src/client/chat/AssistantMarkdown.module.css`
- `ui-chat/src/client/chat/ReasoningRow.module.css`

Do not hand-edit the generated output. Re-run the script after upgrading
the DSH runtime; the class maps are consumed by the server-mode shell.
